purpose: Open-domain evidence-bound per-Sim activity DAG; staged planning/play, safe mobility alternatives, budgets, interruption reconciliation and optional bounded uncertainty estimates

modes.PLANNING: Compile deterministic multi-step candidate queue while gameplay remains paused; no dispatch
modes.PLAY: Reassess current evidence and require separate independent effect permit before each step; source-only policy never dispatches

mechanism.graph: Directed acyclic prerequisites with open-ended domain/activity classifications
mechanism.path: Observed/admitted travel edge; teleport only when independently observed unlocked for actor, otherwise walk when eligible
mechanism.time: Conservative upper-minute bounds; sum plus reserve must fit both work obligation and needs floor
mechanism.money: Cumulative acquisition costs fit verified funds; spending separately authorized and verified
mechanism.recovery: Completed steps require outcome evidence; in-flight blocks replay until observed reconciliation
mechanism.learning: Bounded homogeneous-cohort Gaussian process, RBF, Matern 3/2 or periodic kernel, at most 24 observations, advisory only

invariants: Player input outranks plans; no effect permit, screen automation, save editing, auto-listener or purchase side effect
Open domain names and explicit source-backed prerequisites; never invent native abilities or game facts
Unknown or stale evidence fails closed; unknown path remains deferred
Never duplicate an unresolved in-flight effect; preserve goal intent
Native execution requires separate exact-EA-build evidence and game verification under issue #171
BI-002 independent hunger gate remains open
A planned acquisition whose dependent downstream goal cannot fit the same current safe window must not spend unless an existing owner explicitly resolves partial preparation
required_live_successor: Bind evidence-producing domain adapters and native game-side executor; verify installation, player interrupts, exact-patch rollback and real-world timed chains
